telegram.title: Telegram Managed Bots
telegram.description: Create one dedicated company bot with explicit Telegram owner confirmation, or securely connect an existing bot.

gmail.title: Gmail email
gmail.description: Connect a Google mailbox to tenant-isolated CRM conversations and replies.
gmail.secureTitle: Official Google OAuth and Gmail API
gmail.secureDescription: Only gmail.modify is requested. Access and refresh tokens stay encrypted and write-only; Pub/Sub push is authenticated.
gmail.initialSyncDescription: Import a bounded recent set or begin only with mail received after connection. Historical mail never triggers AI.
gmail.labelPolicy: Only INBOX mail is synchronized; SPAM and TRASH are always excluded.
gmail.readOnly: Gmail settings are read-only for your role or organization state.
gmail.emptyDescription: Connect one mailbox to ingest real email threads into Unified Inbox.

modeDescriptions.suggest: AI creates an email draft for approval.
modeDescriptions.autopilot: AI may send only eligible replies under published context and backend policy.

gmail.detailDescription: OAuth, Pub/Sub watch, synchronization, privacy and delivery health.
gmail.automationDescription: Suggest and autopilot use only the published AI Context. Automated mail, list mail, bounces and historical sync never trigger AI.
gmail.aiPolicy: The model may propose a reply; only the backend may authorize and send it. Gmail data is not used for advertising or hidden model training.
gmail.syncSettingsDescription: Initial limits, immutable safe label defaults, and tenant-owned retention controls.
gmail.verificationDescription: Operational evidence to prepare before moving the OAuth consent screen to production.
gmail.approvalDisclaimer: This checklist documents readiness; it does not claim or guarantee Google approval.

verificationItems.demo_video: OAuth and Gmail workflow demo video

gmail.privacyDescription: Gmail-derived message content is retained for {days} days, then redacted in bounded cleanup jobs.
gmail.privacyMailboxAccess: Access is limited to the connected mailbox and active organization.
gmail.privacyAi: Only eligible new customer mail may use the published AI Context.
gmail.privacyExport: Authorized administrators can export, anonymize, or delete CRM Gmail data through tenant-scoped APIs.
gmail.privacyNoAds: Gmail data is never used for advertising or hidden model training.
gmail.privacyLegalDraft: Legal copy remains a draft until reviewed by qualified counsel.
gmail.disconnectDescription: Disconnect stops users.watch, removes encrypted tokens and blocks new delivery.

sms.title: SMS messaging
sms.description: Connect a tenant-owned sender to Unified Inbox with verified webhooks, consent controls and delivery callbacks.
sms.secureDescription: Twilio requests are validated with the official SDK. Credentials are encrypted and write-only; sender and verified destination select the tenant.
sms.readOnly: SMS settings are read-only for your role or organization state.
sms.setupDescription: Use deterministic fake SMS in development, or an explicitly enabled Twilio account and SMS-capable sender.
sms.writeOnly: Secrets are submitted once, encrypted at rest, cleared from the browser and never returned.
sms.emptyDescription: An owner or administrator can connect a fake or live sender.

modeDescriptions.suggest: AI creates drafts for employee approval.
modeDescriptions.autopilot: AI may reply only after all consent, health and published-context checks pass.

sms.detailDescription: Sender health, exact callback URLs, consent, segmentation and AI policy.
sms.webhooksDescription: Configure these exact HTTPS URLs in Twilio. Proxy/public URL mismatches break signature validation.
sms.exactUrlPolicy: The backend validates the externally visible URL and every received parameter. Organization headers are ignored.
sms.consentDescription: Provider signals remain authoritative. The app blocks opted-out recipients before any send call.
sms.advancedOptOutHint: OptOutType from the verified webhook synchronizes STOP, START and HELP.
sms.inboundSupportHint: A customer-initiated inquiry may establish support consent; opt-out always wins.
sms.consentPolicy: This is product behavior, not legal advice. No campaigns or cold outreach are available.
sms.automationDescription: Suggest and autopilot use the published AI Context and the same tenant-owned CRM conversation.
sms.aiPolicy: AI cannot answer STOP/START/HELP, override consent, exceed its stricter segment limit or bypass delivery health.
sms.testDescription: Creates clearly scoped fake provider data without internet or Twilio credentials.
sms.rotateDescription: Submit replacements only. Existing secret values are never displayed.
sms.connectionActionsDescription: Pause blocks sending and webhooks; disconnect clears customer-owned secrets.

voice.title: Voice AI telephony
voice.description: Configure secure inbound SIP calls, Realtime AI, transfers, and CRM outcomes.
voice.secureDescription: Called number selects the tenant. Credentials, transfer targets, prompts, and raw provider events stay server-side.
voice.legalDescription: Disclosure, transcript consent, retention, and calling rules vary by jurisdiction. Review this draft configuration with counsel before live use.
voice.readOnly: This organization or role can view Voice status but cannot change it.
voice.setupDescription: Use deterministic fake providers for testing or connect a reviewed Twilio SIP/OpenAI Realtime setup.
voice.writeOnly: Carrier credentials are encrypted and write-only. Existing values are never displayed.
voice.emptyDescription: An owner or admin can configure an inbound Voice number.
voice.behaviorDescription: The first turn identifies the AI. Responses stay brief and use server-authorized tools only.
voice.transfersDescription: The AI can propose only a configured key. The encrypted phone or SIP URI never enters model context.
voice.noDestinationsHint: Add a reviewed employee or branch target with callback fallback.
voice.destinationWriteOnly: Transfer destinations are encrypted and write-only. The AI sees keys only.
voice.testDescription: Exercises routing, disclosure, multilingual transcript, summary, and CRM without credentials or public internet.
voice.noCallsHint: Run a fake call or receive a verified inbound call.
voice.transcriptHidden: Transcript was not retained under this call's privacy policy.

webChat.publicStage: Web Chat is available in this stage

webChat.emptyHint: Create one to receive website visitors in Unified Inbox.
webChat.detailDescription: Secure public entrypoint, visitor experience, retention, and delivery health.
webChat.contextMissing: Publish AI Context before AI modes
